hook: Atomic Engine runs Inkling 2 Mini about 3x faster
hookText: Atomic Engine runs Inkling 2 Mini about 3x faster

beats.say: The README's documented Mac profile uses an IQ2M quant plus a 504 MB Q80 drafter and measured 105.71 tokens/s on a 48 GB M4 Max with a 14 GiB budget; the 122 tokens/s M5 Max figure is from the announcement.
We made Inkling 2 Mini 3x faster with 50% less RAM.
Our engine with a drafter reaches 122 tok/s on M5 Max vs 40 tok/s on llama.cpp with no accuracy loss.
